title: This Happens Every Second on Earth
description: Babies, lightning, emails, oil, the Sun and your own blood: what happens on Earth in a single second.

scenes.label: 1 second
scenes.text: In the next second, all of this will happen on our planet, and you won't notice any of it.

scenes.label: babies born
scenes.text: Around four babies will be born.

scenes.label: lightning strikes
scenes.text: Lightning will strike the ground about forty times.

scenes.label: emails sent
scenes.text: People will send about four million emails.

scenes.label: barrels of oil
scenes.text: The world will burn through about twelve hundred barrels of oil.

scenes.label: tons of water
scenes.text: Sixteen million tons of water will rise from the seas into the sky.

scenes.label: around the Sun
scenes.text: Our planet will race thirty kilometers along its path around the Sun.

scenes.label: tons of the Sun
scenes.text: And the Sun will turn four million tons of itself into pure energy.

scenes.label: new blood cells
scenes.text: Inside your body, two million new red blood cells will be made.

scenes.label: just 1 second
scenes.text: All of that, in just one second. Follow for more.
